initialAllocation.name: Three cofounders
initialAllocation.note: The deployment manifest labels this holding as infrastructure; the project owner clarified on 2026-10-21 that the 300000 BRB allocation is for the three cofounders. Its bank-vault share position remains team-controlled and is excluded from the estimate below.

snapshot.method: ERC20 totalSupply minus the marketing wallet BRB balance, founder holding-wallet BRB balance and convertToAssets value of founder-held BRB-bank shares, all read at the same block. Other public bank-vault shares are not treated as team reserves.

limitations: This is a dated disclosure, not a live supply API or independent aggregator verification.
Initial liquidity allocation is not the current pool balance or current circulating supply.
Wallet classification is based on project-owner confirmation that marketing and founder allocations are the team reserves. The final supply classification remains subject to aggregator review.
No founder vesting contract or off-chain vesting agreement is asserted. Fully allocated tokens may still be excluded from circulating supply when held by the team.
The deployment manifest states that LP tokens remain with the deployer and that no on-chain LP vesting lock was deployed or funded. No liquidity-lock claim is made.
convertToAssets is a share-accounting value, not immediately withdrawable cash; withdrawals are queued and fees apply.
Vault returns depend on gaming activity and outcomes and may be negative. No guaranteed yield or capital protection is offered.
